name: KinFlo hosted Convex activation packet

providerBoundary.notes: This packet prepares human approvals and evidence targets only. It does not provision Convex, run codegen, import generated API, execute live Convex functions, touch provider APIs, or read/print secrets.

humanApprovalGates.decision: Approve history purge or private-repo residual-risk posture before public/client sharing.
Approve hosted Convex project ownership, billing, backup, auth, and environment setup.
Approve running npm run convex:codegen and reviewing generated bindings.
Approve replacing fixture reads with generated API bindings one adapter at a time.
Approve running the ordered live smoke manifest against hosted Convex.
Approve each non-Convex provider separately: DNS, SSL, Vercel domain, Stripe, SendGrid, Twilio, storage, AI.

orderedPreActivationChecks.evidence: No tracked secret-like files; residual history risk decision recorded.
Env references inventoried without secret values.
Preflight passes immediately before hosted setup/codegen.
Runtime function registry and generated API contract remain aligned.
Live smoke manifest is parseable, ordered, and provider-light.
Ordered activation packet printed and saved in deployment notes.
Live handoff checklist passes with generated API still gated.
Convex modules typecheck before codegen approval.

hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.action: Create or select hosted Convex project owned by Vambah.
hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.evidence: Convex dashboard project URL and owner/billing/backup notes captured outside chat.

hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.action: Configure CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT, VITE_CONVEX_URL, CONVEX_AUTH_ISSUER, and CONVEX_AUTH_CLIENT_ID outside committed source.
hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.evidence: Env values confirmed present without printing secrets.

hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.action: Run npm run convex:codegen after approval.
Run read-only hosted smokes first: activation.readiness, viewer, role/access reads, tenant/site reads, launchReadiness.getSiteLaunchReadiness.
hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.evidence: Read-only smoke outputs saved with tenant/site scope proof.

hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.action: Run mutation smokes in docs/convex-live-smoke-manifest.json order.
hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.evidence: Audit events, rollback notes, and smoke record ids captured.

hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.action: Switch adapters one surface at a time only after its smoke evidence passes.
hostedExecutionSequenceAfterApproval.evidence: Runtime boundary diff reviewed and rollback path confirmed.

rollbackRequirements: Keep generatedApiAvailable false until a reviewed adapter switch is committed.
Archive or label all smoke tenants, sites, leads, invitations, domains, campaigns, and AI records as smoke data.
Return affected shell surfaces to fixture adapters if any read-only scope check fails.
Pause mutation/provider steps immediately on any cross-tenant permission failure.
Do not attach domains, send emails/SMS, create Stripe resources, upload storage objects, or call AI providers from this packet.
evidenceTargets: launchReadiness.getSiteLaunchReadiness hosted output for Julie and one new client site
publicSite.resolvePublishedSite hosted output for a published smoke page
crm.submitLead smoke lead id plus crm.listLeads scoped proof
controlPlane.listAuditEvents audit entries for identity, activation, site creation, invitation, publish, and lead capture
cross-tenant deny proof for client admin role
